vetSays.line: 🛡️ Hannah, Heinrich and Lars met them at the door — 3 put down. Hannah, Heinrich, Lars are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Lars, Ciro and Fatima met them at the door — 3 put down. Lars, Ciro, Fatima are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannah just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hannah, Fatima and Stan met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Hannah, Fatima, Stan are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Fatima — Craft 2. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Fatima chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 2.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Heinrich just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hannah, Fatima, Stan, Aria and Adaeze met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Hannah, Fatima, Stan, Adaeze are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Benjawan and Tom met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Benjawan, Tom are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Benjawan, Tom and Natividad met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Benjawan, Tom, Natividad are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Fatima Hassan, 48 — a paramedic. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Cold-Blooded, Scar Tissue, Feast Engine.
